deviceConfigFields.label: IP address
deviceConfigFields.help: The address of the machine running SAStudio4. On a handheld PXN that is the analyzer itself.

deviceConfigFields.label: Control port
deviceConfigFields.help: The SCPI control port, shown in SAStudio4 under System > SCPI. The default is 5025. This is not the data port (5125), which this plugin does not use.

pluginConfigFields.label: Analyzer addresses
pluginConfigFields.help: Addresses to look for analyzers at, separated by commas — for example `192.168.1.100, 192.168.1.101:5026`. Only used to fill the device picker; a device added by hand does not need to be listed here.

pluginConfigFields.label: Pause between sweeps
pluginConfigFields.help: How long to wait after reading a trace before asking for the next one. Zero reads as fast as the analyzer answers, which on a handheld costs battery and CPU for very little extra resolution in time.
